heroHeadline: Artemis II Crew at CSA HQ Virtual Event (Day 2 Canada Tour); IFT-12 Still NET May 19; Artemis III Hardware Advancing at KSC
heroSubtitle: May 14: All four Artemis II crew members (Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen) held a bilingual public virtual event at Canadian Space Agency headquarters in Saint-Hubert, QC — 11:30 AM–12:30 PM ET, live on CSA YouTube and Facebook — marking Day 2 of the crew's three-city Canada tour (Ottawa May 13, CSA HQ May 14, Montreal Place des Arts May 15). The Saint-Hubert event spotlights Canadian Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen, the first non-American on a lunar trajectory, and Canada's ongoing partnership with NASA following Gateway's March 2026 cancellation. SpaceX IFT-12 (Starship V3 — Booster 19 + Ship 39) maintains its NET May 19 window at 5:30 PM CDT (22:30 UTC) with no slips reported as of May 14; the V3 debut will validate docking port and propellant-transfer hardware critical for Artemis III HLS qualification. At KSC: the Artemis III SLS core stage is stacking in VAB High Bay 2, and the Artemis III Orion ESM has completed acoustic testing at the O&C facility — both on track for a late 2027 Earth-orbit docking test mission. Day 34 post-splashdown: Artemis II Orion heat shield visual inspection continues at KSC's Multi-Payload Processing Facility; formal Marshall X-ray scans and Avcoat sample extractions remain on track for summer 2026. Artemis Accords at 67 nations.
